content.user_title: Audit Domain Authority Against Trusted Peers
content.value_statement: Domain authority scores can mislead when evidence, market context, or peer comparisons are incomplete. This skill applies a 40-item CITE audit with explicit coverage and veto checks.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates 40 citation, identity, trust, and eminence items for one domain.
Compares evidence against a declared market, stage, domain profile, and peer cohort.
Tracks missing evidence as Unknown instead of assigning unsupported scores.
Checks verified manipulation, backlink incoherence, manual action, and deindexing veto conditions.
Produces CITE dimension results, evidence coverage, confidence, priorities, and rerun conditions.
limitations: Requires a defined peer cohort, market, entity stage, domain profile, and observation date.
Cannot produce a comparable score when applicable evidence or the verified scoring runtime is unavailable.
Does not replace page-level content audits, technical SEO checks, or dedicated backlink analysis.
Provides an advisory trust assessment and cannot predict whether an answer engine will cite a domain.

use_cases.title: Establish a Domain Baseline
use_cases.description: Measure a domain against same-stage peers before setting authority and citation goals.

use_cases.title: Review Acquisition Risk
use_cases.description: Check trust evidence, manipulation signals, and unresolved data gaps before acquiring or partnering with a domain.

use_cases.title: Track Publisher Authority
use_cases.description: Repeat a locked-cohort audit to measure changes in citation trust and prioritize evidence-backed improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Domain Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit {domain} for domain authority. Use {market}, {entity stage}, {domain profile}, and these peers: {peer list}. Mark missing evidence Unknown.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a structured audit with complete context.

prompt_templates.title: Evidence-Gap Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review {domain} against {peer list}. Identify missing CITE evidence, explain which items remain Unknown, and list the data needed before scoring.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare data collection before a full audit.

prompt_templates.title: Cohort Rerun
prompt_templates.prompt: Rerun the CITE audit for {domain} using the prior locked cohort and {observation date}. Compare evidence coverage, dimensions, vetoes, and priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Measure progress without changing benchmark context.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Veto Investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit {domain} with dated backlink, traffic, console, entity, and citation evidence. Verify T03, T05, and T09 separately against {peer cohort}.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess high-impact manipulation or penalty concerns.

output_examples.input: Audit example.com against five same-stage United States software peers. Private console data is unavailable.
output_examples.output: Verdict: UNDECIDED. The cohort is valid, but penalty evidence remains Unknown. No total score is issued until the evidence gap is resolved.

output_examples.input: Rerun a product-service domain with complete evidence and one verified manual-action failure.
output: The verified veto caps the final score at 59.
Resolve the manual action, document confirmation, and rerun with the same cohort.

best_practices: Lock the peer cohort, market, stage, profile, and evidence window before evaluating any item.
Record source dates and distinguish measured, estimated, proxy, and user-provided evidence.
Verify every veto with positive evidence and preserve Unknown states when private or comparison data is missing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat absolute authority metrics as universal thresholds across markets or domain types.
Do not convert unavailable evidence into a pass, partial result, failure, or unsupported total score.
Do not infer manipulation from domain youth, WHOIS privacy, low volume, or a temporary launch spike alone.

faq.question: What does CITE measure?
faq.answer: CITE reviews citation, identity, trust, and eminence signals for one domain relative to a defined peer cohort.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate a domain authority metric?
faq.answer: It produces a peer-relative advisory profile when all required evidence and the verified scoring runtime are available.

faq.question: What information must I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the domain, market, entity stage, domain profile, observation date, peer cohort, and available evidence sources.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: Applicable missing evidence remains Unknown. The skill does not issue a comparable total score until required coverage is complete.

faq.question: Can it confirm a search penalty?
faq.answer: It requires verified manual-action or material deindexing evidence. Public index absence alone cannot confirm a penalty.

faq.question: Can it audit individual pages or backlinks?
faq.answer: No. Use a page-quality auditor for individual content and a dedicated offsite analyzer for detailed backlink diagnosis.
